coder_notes: Carboplatin is the candidate with focused-ultrasound BBB-opening delivery (C12/R5): device_dependent true even though patients were already planned for carboplatin. Microbubbles are not a registered intervention but the official title states BBBD with microbubbles for every procedure; moiety perflutren inferred from the exclusion criterion (record does not name the microbubble product explicitly). Gadolinium contrast is used to assess BBB opening on MRI (device outcome), not listed as an agent. Primary outcomes are safety and BBB opening; no tumour PK or candidate pharmacodynamic measurement.
